critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in /app/backend/server.py line 3513-3528: Daily timeline endpoint was failing with 'TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'. Fixed by ensuring all datetime objects are timezone-aware before comparison.
All 38 features from the test checklist have been verified working
Multi-tenant data isolation is working correctly - franchise users cannot access other franchise data
Platform admin impersonation is working correctly with proper audit logging
All CRUD operations for tenants, users, vehicles, bookings are functional
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing: multiple test tenants, test users, test vehicles, test bookings, test invoices
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 38 features from the pre-launch QA checklist have been tested and verified working. Key findings: 1) Super Admin Franchise Control Centre fully functional with Overview, Tenants, Users, Reports & Billing, and Audit Log tabs. 2) Tenant Dashboard fully functional with Overview, Fleet (Live Status, Car Calendars, All Cars Calendar, Manage Vehicles), Bookings, Team, Reports (Analytics, Fleet Reports, Daily Timeline), and Announcements tabs. 3) Multi-tenant isolation working correctly. 4) Fixed timezone comparison bug in daily timeline endpoint. 5) All CRUD operations working. 6) PDF/CSV exports working. 7) QR code generation working. 8) Impersonation working with proper audit logging.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug found in /app/backend/server.py get_daily_availability_timeline function: When parsing booking start/end times from ISO format strings, the resulting datetime objects could be timezone-naive if the original string didn't include timezone info. This caused a TypeError when comparing with timezone-aware hour_start_aware and hour_end_aware. Fixed by explicitly checking if booking_start/booking_end are timezone-naive and adding UTC timezone if needed.
